## Description {#details}

<p>A pass for printing the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/phivalues">PhiValues</a> for a function.</p>


<p>This pass doesn't print whatever information the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/phivalues">PhiValues</a> happens to hold, but instead first uses the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/phivalues">PhiValues</a> to analyze all the phis in the function so the complete information is printed.</p>


<p>Definition at line 129 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/analysis/phivalues-h">PhiValues.h</a>.</p>
